plan.title: feat(scope): batch promote multi-scope pin; keep one active implement

narratives.Description: feat(scope): batch promote multi-scope pin; keep one active implement
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

Strict one-scope-at-a-time **promote → activate → implement** for N scopes multiplies tool turns (e.g. 12 scopes × several lifecycle commands). That is the largest structural turn cost for multi-scope greenfield. Parallel swarm is not the single-agent app-bank path.

## Goal

Allow **batch promote** of the pin (or explicit list) while preserving **one active implement** (hooks, file_scope, story-ready).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Documented (and preferably CLI-supported) path to batch-promote `xbrief/proposed/` → `pending/` for a multi-scope pin
- [ ] Implement path remains: one `scope:activate` + implement at a time; no multi-active write fence
- [ ] Build skill / multi-scope guidance: do not re-list the entire tree every scope when order is known
- [ ] Tests for batch promote if new CLI surface
- [ ] CHANGELOG / commands.md

## Non-goals

- Activating all scopes at once
- Dropping xBRIEF lifecycle or WIP cap
- Replacing swarm for true parallel worktrees

## Parent

Part of multi-scope turn/cache budget epic (post-v0.90 ceremony).
